test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: A policeman chases a thief. The speed of the policeman and thief are 18 km/h and 6 km/h, respectively. If the policeman started 10 minutes late, at what distance will he catch the thief?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of Policeman = 18 km/h

Speed of Thief = 6 km/h

Time delay for Policeman = 10 minutes = 10/60 hours = 1/6 hours

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculations:**

Distance covered by T
